No function other than `pkgver()` is executed during sourcing, and `pkgver()` itself is not evaluated during `--printsrcinfo` unless explicitly called — which it is not.

The rest of the functions (`build`, `package`) are defined but not executed during this command. There is no evidence of code exfiltration, unauthorized downloads, or execution of remote payloads during the sourcing phase. The file adheres to typical AUR packaging patterns and presents no immediate danger when processed by `makepkg --printsrcinfo`.
